sampling: Order eligible entity IDs by SHA256(seed:entity_id); select the lexically first label chain of each entity, first deposited model. Split by SHA256(seed:cluster_anchor) modulo 2, 0 selection and 1 heldout. Retain at most one entity per RCSB 30-percent sequence cluster and one entity per PDB entry; fill metadata-only length/completeness quotas without examining model outputs. Parser/download failures and excess-quota candidates are logged outside source control.
sequence_source: deposited mmCIF polymer sequence; no observed-sequence fallback
synthetic_sources: Only complete original chains; one internal gap and one N-terminal gap per length plus an oxygen-only omission
context: independent singleton full-chain inference, no production cropping
hard_gates: Unique chain and cluster identities with disjoint selection/heldout groups
Frozen source-file and manifest hashes remain unchanged
Sequence positions and original coordinate/atom-mask snapshots match parsed source and every condition
All conditions use identical original token/geometry/scoring masks and report every exclusion
Available token IDs are in range and decoded coordinates are finite; missing outputs remain NaN
No imputed coordinates become evaluation targets or exported targets
Model states are unchanged; padding and supported grouping change zero available IDs
quality_gate: For source and each admitted synthetic variant separately, require at least five paired chains and the lower bound of the existing 1000-resample chain-level bootstrap 95-percent interval for candidate-minus-reference lDDT-CA and Kabsch-TM to be >= -0.02. Baseline self-differences are exactly zero. These are predeclared engineering noninferiority budgets for this use, not universal biological accuracy thresholds.
selection_ranking: Among quality-eligible native policies, minimize pooled rigid-transform changed-ID rate across admitted source and synthetic cases; then minimize maximum observed-atom displacement on working coordinates; then maximize source mean lDDT-CA; then break exact ties observed_only, linear, reference. Keep unknown/polymer conditions diagnostic only.
heldout_rule: Freeze a separate choice for Lite and Large using selection results only, before running any heldout inference. Apply identical gates once on heldout. If a gate fails, report failed qualification and do not package that candidate as a qualified stable policy; do not change budgets or select another policy using heldout results.
limitations: Metadata-stratified bounded public cohort is not an unbiased sample of the PDB or an internal dataset
RCSB sequence clusters reduce close sequence overlap; they do not prove structural-family independence
Pretrained tokenizer training-set overlap is unknown; heldout means held out of this policy-selection experiment
Synthetic missing positions stay unlabeled; this is not missing-loop recovery
Only deposited first-model chains are processed; no multimer or biological-assembly support is claimed
